title: Giant Unilamellar Vesicles (GUVs) Preparation by Electroformation Method
author: Zehra Kahveci
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rvvd666

steps.title: Prepare lipid solution
steps.instruction: Weigh the phospholipid and dissolve it in chloroform to a final concentration of 10 mM. For fluorescent GUVs, add Texas‑Red‑DHPE from a 1 mM stock to reach a final molar ratio of 1:500.

steps.title: Identify ITO slide conductive side
steps.instruction: Use a multimeter to determine the conductive side of each ITO‑coated slide.

steps.title: Apply lipid film to slide
steps.instruction: Using a 5 µL Hamilton syringe, spread 10 µL of the lipid solution onto the identified conductive side of one ITO slide.

steps.title: Dry lipid film
steps.instruction: Place the slide with the coating side facing up in a vacuum desiccator for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 195 mM sucrose solution in 5 mM HEPES buffer, pH 7.4, and vortex until the sucrose is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Apply vacuum grease to O‑ring
steps.instruction: Spread a thin, even layer of vacuum grease on the O‑ring that will be used in the chamber.

steps.title: Assemble electroformation chamber
steps.instruction: Assemble the Nanion Vesicle Prep Pro chamber with the lipid‑coated slide.

substeps.instruction: Remove the top part of the chamber by unscrewing the screws.
Using tweezers, place the dried‑lipid ITO slide into the chamber with the lipid‑film side pointing upward.
Position the greased O‑ring around the lipid film.
Add 280 µL of the 195 mM sucrose solution into the O‑ring.
Place the second ITO slide on top of the O‑ring, conductive side down, ensuring the right end contacts the right‑side electrode.
Replace the top part of the chamber and carefully screw it back in place.

steps.title: Run electroformation protocol
steps.instruction: Turn on the Nanion VPP, select the following voltage‑frequency program and start: 5 min at 5 Hz, voltage ramp 0 → 3 V; 2 h at 5 Hz, constant 3 V; final 5 min at 5 Hz, voltage ramp 3 → 0 V.

steps.title: Disassemble chamber and collect GUVs
steps.instruction: After the program finishes, unscrew and remove the top part of the chamber, then use tweezers to lift off the top ITO slide.

steps.title: Harvest and inspect GUVs
steps.instruction: Cut the tip of a pipette, gently collect the sample from the ITO‑slide surface, withdraw a 5 µL aliquot of the electroformation product, and examine the GUVs under an epifluorescence microscope.
